description:
As a cemetery administrator
  I want to create and edit plots in the cemetery
  So that I can manage the available burial spaces

elements.name: Create a new plot from the Tables section

steps.name: I am on the Chronicle login page
I enter email "<TEST_EMAIL>"
I enter password "<TEST_PASSWORD>"
I click the login button
I should be logged in successfully
I navigate to the Tables section
I click the Add Plot button
I fill the add plot form with following details
I save the new plot
the new plot should appear in the plots table

elements.name: Edit an existing plot from the plot detail page

steps.name: I am on the Chronicle login page
I enter email "<TEST_EMAIL>"
I enter password "<TEST_PASSWORD>"
I click the login button
I should be logged in successfully
I navigate to all plots page
I open the filter dialog
I select vacant filter
I apply the filter plot
I expand the first section
I select the first vacant plot
I click the Edit Plot button
I update the plot with following details
I save the plot changes
the plot should be updated successfully

elements.name: Delete a plot from the tables section

steps.name: I am on the Chronicle login page

I enter password "<TEST_PASSWORD>"

elements.name: Add Sale to a plot from the Edit Plot page

steps.name: I am on the Chronicle login page
I enter email "<TEST_EMAIL>"
I enter password "<TEST_PASSWORD>"
I click the login button
I should be logged in successfully
I navigate to the advance table and open the first plot
I click the ADD SALE button
I fill sale reference with "<TEST_SALES_REFERENCE>"
I search and select purchaser "<TEST_PURCHASER_FIRST>" "<TEST_PURCHASER_LAST>" in the add person modal
I select the first available item from the Item dropdown
the selected item related plot should match the first plot ID
I click Create and confirm to navigate back to Edit Plot page
I should see a new sale entry with reference "<TEST_SALES_REFERENCE>" on the Edit Plot page
